headline: US Treasury Secretary Demands Nvidia Detail Chip Sales to China
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called on Nvidia to answer questions regarding its chip sales to China. He stated it was too early to determine if Chief Executive Jensen Huang should stay in his role.
why: Nvidia is the dominant global designer of artificial intelligence chips, making its international sales and executive leadership subject to intense political and regulatory scrutiny.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corporation
impacts.why: Scrutiny from the US Treasury Secretary regarding chip sales to China creates regulatory and policy uncertainty.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory pressure from top US officials regarding key market leader Nvidia's sales to China creates concern over potential trade restrictions or leadership disruption.
